item.title: National records for Clifford, Jules in US school athletics - St. Lucia Times
item.description: Two new national marks and a school record were set by Saint Lucian athletes this past weekend, as college teams in the United States got their outdoor track and field seasons underway. Lauralyn Clifford and Naya Jules were the standout performers on the first weekend of North American spring.

item.title: Police investigating Bexon double homicide - St. Lucia Times
item.description: Police are investigating a double homicide in Bexon, Castries, following a shooting that claimed the lives of 22-year-old Mickel Johan Bernard and 23-year-old James Toussaint.

item.title: Pierre projects record 2026-27 budget - St. Lucia Times
item.description: Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre will present a record $2.18 billion budget for Saint Lucia, addressing geopolitical impacts on oil prices and continued fuel subsidies.

item.title: Schools' volleyball finals take place on Tuesday - St. Lucia Times
item.description: New girls' champions will be crowned in Under-19 schools' volleyball, while the defending boys' champions aim for a repeat, as finals take place Tuesday, March 24, at Beausejour Gymnasium. The semifinals were held on Friday at the same venue. Sir Arthur Lewis Community College reached both finals: the boys face St Mary's College, and the girls play Micoud Secondary.

item.title: Special needs athletes shine at Inter-Schools meet - St. Lucia Times
item.description: The Special Education Inter-Schools Sports Meet was held on Thursday, March 19, at the Mindoo Phillip Park, the eve of World Down Syndrome Day. Scores of students with special needs competed in traditional foot races as well as events such as the sack race, lime-and-spoon, beanbag throw, and fill-the-bottle.

item.title: William prepares for US pickleball circuit - St. Lucia Times
item.description: Saint Lucian athlete Meggan William, the only world-ranked Caribbean pickleball player, prepares for a multi-state US circuit to break into the world's top 100.

item.title: Parks, Destang lead Team Saint Lucia to CARIFTA Aquatics - St. Lucia Times
item.description: The Saint Lucia Aquatics Federation has named a 12-member squad led by Antoine Destang and Sapphire Parks for the 2026 CARIFTA Aquatics Championships in Martinique.

item.title: Franchise consultant sees enormous upside in Caribbean market - St. Lucia Times
item.description: Celebrated franchise consultant Chris Conner is confident that the Caribbean market represents a major opportunity for business development. Conner, based in the United States, has achieved massive success as a business development consultant, helping brands such as Jimmy John’s, European Wax Centre, 911 Restoration, Smashburger, Marco’s Pizza, Mad Science Group and others expand into fully functioning franchises.

item.title: Young Boyz to play Azerbaijan in FIFA Series - St. Lucia Times
item.description: A relatively inexperienced iteration of Saint Lucia’s men’s national team will face unfamiliar opposition this week, as the Piton Boyz head to Azerbaijan for their lone fixture in the FIFA Series 2026. Stern John’s squad meet their Eurasian hosts on Friday, March 27, at the Mehdi Huseynzade Stadium in Sumqayit, about 31 kilometres from the capital, Baku.

item.title: Who will be the next Police Commissioner? Ronald Phillip acting for now - St. Lucia Times
item.description: Who will be the next Commissioner of Police? That question now looms over the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force as Deputy Commissioner Ronald Phillip steps into the role in an acting capacity while a final decision is made on the force's leadership.
